  <text x="500" y="942" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172033">T(r) = 100 ln(1/r) / ln(4) °C;   r(T) = 4^(−T/100)</text>
  <text x="500" y="970" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#475569">0.25 ≤ r ≤ 1 · X = 500 + 400x · Y = 500 − 400y</text>
